name: dot-pattern
title: Dot Pattern
description: A background dot pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the SVG. Dots use the text colour.

props.name: width
props.description: Horizontal spacing between dots in pixels.

props.name: height
props.description: Vertical spacing between dots in pixels.

props.name: x
props.description: Horizontal offset of the whole pattern.

props.name: y
props.description: Vertical offset of the whole pattern.

props.name: cx
props.description: Horizontal offset of each dot inside its cell.

props.name: cy
props.description: Vertical offset of each dot inside its cell.

props.name: glow
props.description: Make every dot pulse with a soft glow, each on its own random rhythm.
